name: Enterprise Contract, Obligation and SLA
constraints: WM-ECO-006 masters agreement instruments, expressions, amendments, termination and contract records.
WM-XCT-029 masters duties, directed parties, performance state, evidence, breach, cure and consequences.
Obligations reference stable clause-work identifiers and never duplicate authoritative clause text.
Amendment creates a successor expression and preserves signed predecessors.
Amendment, novation and a new contract remain distinct operations.
Partial fulfilment retains explicit outstanding quantity.
Evidence revocation appends reopening and never rewrites prior findings.
Contested performance is explicit and blocks automatic disposition.
A contractual SLA requires executed incorporation, obligee, enforceable criteria and consequences.
An internal SLO has no contractual force without incorporation by agreement or amendment.
